scientific_limitations: The new proof excludes four-or-fewer-color solutions only for six broadcast-dominating layers on the two-way infinite path.
The five-color upper witness is established in the source paper and is independently checked here; its discovery is not claimed.
The proof makes no claim about other numbers of layers, uniqueness of witnesses, or finite-path threshold behaviour.
Prior-literature assessment is not a guarantee against unindexed equivalent results.
title: Five colors are necessary and sufficient for six packing-domatic broadcasts on the two-way infinite path
